title: NetworkPresenceUpdateRequest
description: network.presence-update-request@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/me/presence on OpenVibe.Network. Every field is optional; only the fields sent change. state is the person's chosen state (auto: online or away from heartbeats, dnd, invisible); status_text and emoji are theirs; show_status is the 'Show my status' switch. An empty body is refused.

state.description: The chosen state. auto derives online or away from the newest heartbeat and the last input.

status_text.description: The status line; null clears it. Markup and control characters are stripped.

emoji.description: One emoji, or null to clear it. More than one grapheme cluster is refused.

show_status.description: The 'Show my status' switch (default on). Off reads as offline to everyone, like invisible.
